people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Esau_Mount
people.line: Mountainous region of Edom; judgment prophesied by Obadiah

translations.web: “Won’t I in that day”, says Yahweh, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?
translations.bsb: In that day, declares the LORD, will I not destroy the wise men of Edom and the men of understanding in the mountains of Esau?
translations.kjv: Shall I not in that day, saith the LORD, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
translations.asv: Shall I not in that day, saith Jehovah, destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
